# Helix24 Solutions

> Helix24 Solutions Pvt Ltd is a digital marketing and web development company in Kochi, Kerala, India (CIN U62011KL2026PTC107185). It serves businesses across Kerala (Kochi, Kozhikode/Calicut, Thiruvananthapuram/Trivandrum) and the UAE/GCC. Services: social media marketing and Meta Ads (Facebook & Instagram), Google Ads, SEO and local Google Maps ranking, websites, e-commerce stores, mobile apps, and branding/UI design. Contact: +91 9048009044, info@helix24.in.

## Services

- [Digital Marketing & SEO](https://helix24.in/digital-marketing-seo): Google Ads, SEO, local Google Maps ranking and Meta Ads for Kerala businesses
- [Social Media Marketing](https://helix24.in/social-media-marketing): Instagram and Facebook content, Reels, community management, Meta Ads and WhatsApp lead funnels
- [Website Development](https://helix24.in/web-development): Fast Next.js websites, web applications and CMS
- [E-Commerce Development](https://helix24.in/ecommerce-development): Shopify, WooCommerce and headless online stores
- [Mobile App Development](https://helix24.in/mobile-app-development): iOS, Android and Flutter apps
- [Branding & Design](https://helix24.in/branding-design): Logo, brand identity, UI/UX and video creatives

## Locations

- [Kochi](https://helix24.in/locations/kochi): Registered office; Kakkanad, Infopark and Ernakulam
- [Kozhikode (Calicut)](https://helix24.in/locations/kozhikode): Calicut and the Malabar region
- [Trivandrum](https://helix24.in/locations/trivandrum): Technopark and Thiruvananthapuram
